source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 暗劲回拉，逆掌翻局
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC22 after EP02 SC21 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from Tuobaye being beaten and the white dragon-deer rushing in, into the next reversal: a hidden force yanks Tuobaye backward out of danger, the white-clothed woman secretly assists again, Tuobaye suddenly counterattacks and knocks Shisilang down, the crowd is stunned, and Keshadu begins to realize someone powerful is helping from behind.
title: 暗劲回拉，逆掌翻局

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC21 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC21 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH04 required storyboard regeneration before pass.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 十四郎毒鞭连落，拓拔野伤痕累累，白龙鹿怒扑护主。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 危急之际，一股暗劲忽然将拓拔野朝后拉开，十四郎一瞬失衡。白衣女子继续暗中以内力相助，却依旧不公开出手。拓拔野在狼狈之中借势反击，一掌或一脚将十四郎打得跌退甚至摔倒，众人瞬间目瞪口呆。科沙度迅速意识到，这不是拓拔野一人能做到的反转，背后必有人以高强内力或术法遥控相助。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后众人会从震惊转向追查幕后相助者，科沙度与白衣女子之间的暗线压迫感将进一步升高。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and controlled; her aid must stay covert, shown through gaze, posture, or invisible force effects rather than overt spellcasting spectacle.
Shisilang is still the on-screen aggressor at the start of the segment, but the reversal must make him look stunned and publicly embarrassed rather than mortally harmed.
Keshadu must read as colder and more perceptive than the crowd; his reaction should suggest immediate deduction, not generic surprise alone.
The white dragon-deer should remain in the same gate-space continuity and can appear protective or startled, but must not hijack the reversal into a creature showcase.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: hidden pull, Tuobaye's involuntary reset, counterattack landing, crowd shock, and Keshadu's deduction should each read as distinct visual steps.
